title: Week 2 saw one fine for a hip-drop tackle, two fines for hits on defenseless players

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Week 2 saw one fine for a hip-drop tackle, two fines for hits on defenseless players
sources.description: The NFL adopted a new policy regarding five player safety rules this offseason and the announcement of fines for Week 2 showed that there were three fouls in those categories.
